region.label: Azure Region

language.title: Language
language.opusMtLocked: Set by the active OPUS-MT model ({{name}}).
language.sourceHint: Auto-detect uses each party's recognition language, unless that is set to auto-detect too.
language.nativeNote: Parties the speech engine translates (Soniox) switch to a new target the next time recognition starts.

autoStart.label: Translate when a meeting starts
autoStart.description: Live translation starts on. The overlay's Translate button changes this too.

selection.label: Select-to-translate toolbar
selection.description: Show a translate button when selecting text in the transcript

postMeeting.label: Show translations in post-meeting review
postMeeting.description: Display translation toolbar and cached translations when reviewing past meetings

cache.label: Cache translations
cache.description: Store translated text locally to avoid re-translating the same content

settle.label: Wait before translating a line
settle.description: A live line is translated once it has stopped changing for this long (or the speaker starts a new line).

endpoint.label: Service URL
endpoint.trimmed: Recognized as a full address: {{path}} is added by the app.

hint.deepl: Leave empty for the official API (free or pro, by key). Or a compatible server such as DeepLX: the prefix ending in /v2.
hint.microsoft: Leave empty for the global endpoint. Or a resource endpoint (https://<resource>.cognitiveservices.azure.com/translator/text/v3.0), or https://api.translator.azure.cn.
hint.google: Leave empty for the official Cloud Translation v2 API, or enter a proxy that serves the same API.

llm.title: LLM translation
llm.modelNote: The model is chosen in AI Models → Task routing → Live translation. Pick a fast model and turn thinking off for live use.

systemPrompt.label: System prompt
systemPrompt.hint: Empty uses the default shown above. {source}, {target} and {glossary} are filled in.

userTemplate.label: Message template
userTemplate.hint: Empty uses the default. {source}, {target}, {glossary} and {text} (the line to translate) are filled in; languages are given by name.

glossary.label: Glossary
glossary.placeholder:
Kubernetes => Kubernetes
sprint => 冲刺
OKR => 目标与关键成果
glossary.hint: One term per line: source => translation. Only the terms that occur in a line are sent with it.

llm.testOk: The model translated a test sentence ({{ms}} ms):

parties.title: Who to translate
parties.nativeUnavailable: {{engine}} can't translate by itself. Choose an engine that can (Soniox) for this party in the speech recognition settings.
parties.hint: Speech engine: the engine translates while it recognizes (Soniox), into the target language above, and the translation service isn't used for that party.

quickSetup.title: Translation
quickSetup.intro: Translate the live transcript while you meet. You can change all of this later in Settings → Translation.

native.hint: Fastest, no extra service needed. Other parties use the translation service below.
